Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to manage the lifecycle of data pipelines, from design and build to deployment and maintenance.
In this role, you will translate business needs and rules for specific use cases or data products into comprehensive data definitions, data models, and data quality requirements. You will rely on a thorough understanding of business processes and underlying data to transform raw data into actionable information and insights.
 Responsibilities
Manage the full lifecycle of data pipelines, including design, build, deployment, and maintenance
Translate business needs and rules into comprehensive data definitions, data models, and data quality requirements
Analyze data sources and define the most suitable data structure based on the nature of the use case (reporting, analytics, operational) and expected level of service
Perform source-to-target mapping during the design phase
Leverage CI/CD pipelines to promote code and execute quality assurance checks, ensuring robust, performant, and scalable data pipelines
Conduct root cause analysis in case of service disruptions, acting as 3rd line of support to debug code and restore services
Collaborate daily with the Lead Data Engineer and Solution Architect to align on requirements and architecture guidelines
Transform raw data into actionable insights that support business decision-making
 Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or another technically oriented discipline
Minimum of 5 years of prior experience in a related role
Understanding of the data lifecycle value chain and underlying components (ETL/ELT, DWH/Data Lake)
Familiarity with SDLC tools and frameworks (CI/CD, automation, monitoring)
Previous experience working in a scaled agile environment
Excellent command of written and spoken English (B2+ level)
 Nice to have
Experience in retail, marketing, supply chain, or finance
Agile/SAFe certifications
Azure Data Engineer certification or AWS/GCP equivalent
Azure Solutions Architect certification or AWS/GCP equivalent
Certified Data Management Professional (DAMA)
 We offer
Full access to cutting-edge tools and technologies
Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
All-around Social package: professional & soft skills training, medical & family care programs, sports
Free English classes
Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
Continuous experience exchange with experts and professionals worldwide
Friendly team and comfortable working environment
Engineering, corporate, and social events within and outside the Company
Flexible working schedule
Opportunities for self-realization
